_meta.critical_caveat: Yassarnā is EDITION-SPECIFIC. Lesson count, pages, and per-page line layout differ between publishers/printings. There is no single global canonical pagination like the Madinah muṣḥaf. DO NOT seed fixed numbers — capture the structure from the SCHOOL'S actual copy, or let the school enter it.
_meta.recommendation: Model Yassarnā as a GENERIC ordered-lesson book (structure_type='ordered_lessons'), seeded per-school (or per-edition) rather than as a single global book. Provide a school-editable lesson list.
